scope: Frozen Windows Foundation acceptance runner readiness; offline evidence only
approvalMeaning: May request the separately authorized one-time budget. This review does not grant live execution, create user authorization, approve model availability or count as human acceptance.

independentChecks.differentialValidation: The first four integration scenarios ran under v1. Final v2 changes only README.md, integration-test.cjs and the narrow case-budget refusal branch/offline injection in run.cjs; that branch was separately exercised with the actual EXE. No claim that all five scenarios were rerun under one final identity.

closedFindings.result: Application attempts including observed local failures are reconciled to durable accounting; budget refusals retain their boundary identity.
Known usage survives errors, unknown/conflicting usage stops and remains null; bounded terminal evidence persists raw usage and response/error details.
Cancellation is durable and waits for the managed Windows process tree; synthetic descendant, timeout and signal tests pass.

Malformed JSON/protocol is stopped before implicit JSON repair. RevisionRecovery is rejected. Valid read aliases, incremental full expansion, cached evidence and frozen JSON decoding remain compatible.
Strict command allowlist excludes scripted accept/acceptanceAccept. Fixed drafts remain byte-identical and cannot become ready for acceptance.
Explicit approval binds one runId/output and matching identities; exclusive durable consumption rejects reuse and changed output.
Per-admission/restart identity checks cover frozen product, runner, calling/cancellation dependencies and future approved CLI hash.
G00 and F03 content checkpoints omit system verdict/gold, bind the current content, reject stale/missing approval and retain the original deadline; they never count as human acceptance.
Only a fully matched, unforwarded, case-scoped LEDGER_CASE_BUDGET refusal may avoid global stop; actual EXE injection proves later cases continue.

limitations: All replies/usage in this stage are synthetic. Hallucination, false-block, false-release rates and actual token cost remain unmeasured.
Live mode requires a new explicit user budget approval, a one-time matching authorization file and official CLI binary hash; none was generated or consumed here.
The 700000 input+output token value is an admission/stop threshold, not a provider-enforced hard cap; an in-flight call may exceed it.
The live protocol gate and independent checkpoint verdicts remain mandatory. Offline integration intentionally skipped semantic decisions and unit-tested their waiting/refusal logic.
Future checkpoint reviewers must receive only the projected content before viewing system outcomes. AI independent review is not human acceptance.
Actual model availability/authentication and the official live CLI route remain unprobed; no credentials or user model configuration were read by this review.
No platform-wide regression, full Agent/A-D acceptance, macOS acceptance or comparative historical token-saving claim is established.
